title: Signal Sprinter
premise: A neon cyber-factory idle game where the player launches robotic courier signals onto a conveyor line, earns credits when they sell offscreen, and reinvests into automation, faster throughput, higher payouts, and viral bonus chances.
interaction_model: Single-screen tap/click incremental game with one main production button, a vertical upgrade list, a prestige reset, and passive offline earnings recovery.
objective: Generate as many credits as possible by transmitting courier bots, purchasing upgrades, and eventually resetting the network for permanent multiplier growth.
progression: The player starts with manual taps, unlocks auto-launching, improves conveyor speed and sale value, adds a random 5x viral payout chance, then performs rebirth resets at a high-money threshold to permanently double future earnings.
theme: Cyberpunk broadcast factory with robot courier bots, neon relays, and signal-network branding.
mood: Flashy, futuristic, energetic, and lightly playful, with satisfying payout spikes and soft idle progression.
likely_audience: Players who enjoy casual clickers, mobile idle games, prestige loops, and visually readable sci-fi dashboards.
confidence_notes: High confidence that the implemented game is primarily a clicker/idle prestige game.
High confidence that the main loop is manual production into automation into rebirth.

Moderate confidence on exact fiction because the code mixes labels such as Neon Signal Factory, Signal Sprinter, and robot courier broadcast line, but they all point to the same neon delivery/broadcast fantasy.
recreation_prompt: Create a polished single-screen mobile-friendly idle clicker called Signal Sprinter set in a neon cyber-factory. The player starts on a dark futuristic dashboard with a glowing conveyor belt running across the screen and taps a large TRANSMIT button to launch small robot courier signal units from the left side onto the belt. Each unit travels automatically to the right and, when it exits the screen, it converts into credits shown in a top HUD. Build the full progression loop around earning, upgrading, automating, and prestiging: include upgrades for auto-launching units at timed intervals, increasing belt speed so units cash out faster, increasing the value of each sale, and increasing the chance of a viral critical payout worth 5x normal value. Add a rebirth or network reset feature at a high-money threshold that wipes current money and upgrade levels but permanently doubles future earnings. Include offline earnings recovery based on time away if automation has been unlocked. Present everything with a glossy sci-fi UI: neon cyan and magenta accents, glowing panels, a start screen, floating payout text, satisfying button press feedback, upgrade cards in a scrollable list, and celebratory or failure feedback for good and blocked actions. Make the controls simple tap/click interactions only, with the canvas scene mostly observational while the player manages timing and economy. Keep the tone energetic, stylish, and rewarding, like a compact prestige clicker with conveyor-factory flavor rather than a skill-based runner.
